facts.fact: AUDA-NEPAD reports that government, private-sector and civil-society representatives met in Moroni on 24-25 August 2026 at a workshop to review and validate the National Data Governance Strategy 2027-2031, whose implementation plan was also examined; it does not report approval or launch by the government.

facts.fact: Research ICT Africa says the Comoros validated its first National Data Strategy, delivered through the DataCipation project with the African Union, EU and GIZ after multistakeholder sessions; it states no approval or launch by the government, and gives no event date, so the post date of 2026-08-26 is used.

note: The Council of Ministers on 18 March 2026 only took note of a proposal to create a working group to draft a national data governance strategy: a stated intention, with no drafting reported begun and no body named to carry out a policy.

facts.fact: Research ICT Africa says it helped deliver a validated national data policy and strategy for the Comoros.
